project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-228 Fleet State (Auto-as-Manager wave, chain 5/6)
description: STACKED branch: ralph/prd-228-fleet-state ← ralph/prd-225-ask-me (chain 5/6; 227+224+226+225 are IN your tree — the read-model should surface 224's ticket watches and 225's open asks; diff scope = merge-base vs the 225 branch). Spec seeded at docs/PRDS/PRD-228-FLEET-STATE.md; wave map docs/PRDS/PRD-WAVE-AUTO-MANAGER.md. SCOPE = one read-model over existing state (NO new writes, NO new state semantics): per-agent current work, leases, queue depth, blocked+open asks, active watches, last activity, period cost; a GET /api/v1/fleet route; a platform_fleet_status tool (included in the heartbeat orchestrator context); a live fleet view in the Agents surface. BAKED DECISIONS (Gerard 2026-08-27, from PRD-228 §8 proposals): the fleet view lives as a TAB inside the Agents page (agent-management.tsx tab set — roster|org-chart|configuration|skills gains 'fleet'); cost source = the SAME canonical source the existing credit/usage surfaces read — pin it during US-001 by grepping what the billing/usage UI queries, record the choice in the PR body, and if two genuinely rival sources exist reply RALPH_BLOCKED naming both (do NOT invent a new store or pick blind); period = ROLLING 24H, labeled as such in the UI. ANCHORS (verified 2026-08-27 — RE-VERIFY by grep): board leases/status core/models/core.py:1558-1643 (lease_until :1592-1597, assigned_agent_id, blocked_at/blocked_reason) + services/board_dispatcher.py (claim :64, renew :272); mission tasks core/models/orchestration.py:156 (state per agent) + the matcher's busy filter modules/coordination/agent_matcher.py:459 (shows how 'busy' is derived today — reuse the derivation); heartbeat state services/heartbeat_service.py:126; watches core/models/watches.py (active by target; 224's board_task type in tree); open asks = approval_grants pending by subject (hot index :97; 225's kind column in tree); frontend agents surface frontend/components/agents/agent-management.tsx:244-276 (tab set), roster frontend/components/agents/agent-roster.tsx; hooks family frontend/hooks/ (extend the EXISTING agents hooks — house rule: no duplicate hooks, no V2 names); route conventions orchestrator/router_manifest.py:50-70 (RouterSpec — new router file needs an entry; PREFER mounting on an existing suitable router if one fits, else one RouterSpec) + orchestrator/reports/route-manifest.json + orchestrator/scripts/dump_routes.py + frontend/scripts/check-route-contract.js (reads frontend/lib/api-client.ts only); heartbeat orchestrator context modules/context/modes.py:66-73 (HEARTBEAT_ORCHESTRATOR, tool_loading='dispatcher_only' — verify how a tool becomes visible there). BINDING RULES: READ-ONLY — the fleet service performs zero writes (grep-enforced: no session.add/commit in the service); NO N+1 (one query set; a query-count assertion test); fail-soft per source (an unavailable source omits its fields, never 500s — clone the channels sender posture); workspace-scoped + permission-checked like the board endpoints (require_workspace_permission read scope — re-verify the exact dependency used by api/board_tasks.py list); ZERO new alembic revisions; NO new tables; ONE new route (GET /api/v1/fleet) with the full manifest procedure (RouterSpec if new router file, regenerate + COMMIT route-manifest.json with bumped count, api-client.ts parity); no os.getenv outside orchestrator/config.py; canonical terms; PURE tests; NEVER 'git add -A'/'git add .'/'-u'; never 'git stash -u'. Frontend gate: cd frontend && npm run -s test green after US-004.

userStories.title: The fleet read-model service
userStories.description: orchestrator/services/fleet_state.py: get_fleet_state(db, workspace_id) → deterministic dict, per active agent: {agent_id, name, current: {kind: 'board_task'|'mission_task'|null, id, title, since} (board task via active lease/status in_progress, else running orchestration task — reuse the matcher's busy derivation, don't invent a rival), queue_depth (assigned-not-started board tasks), blocked: {count, open_asks: [...ids]} (pending question-kind grants against the agent's tasks), watches: {active count}, last_activity_at (max of task activity timestamps — pick cheap existing columns, no new tracking), cost_24h: {tokens, usd} from the pinned canonical source (see baked decision — pin it FIRST, record in the PR body)}. Single query set — no per-agent loops hitting the DB (query-count assertion test with a multi-agent fixture). Fail-soft per source: cost source unavailable → cost fields omitted, everything else intact (test). Zero writes (test greps the service for session mutation calls).
